sentences.text: Dileep -LRB- born Gopalakrishnan Padmanabhan Pillai , on 27 October 1968 -RRB- is an Indian film actor , singer , impressionist , producer , and businessman .	impressionist	Impressionist (entertainment)	producer	film producer
